next_step: Closed-lost; monitor for compliance remediation and re-engage after ISO/SOC2 evidence available (12+ months).
notes:
Status: Closed-lost due to failed security review and unwillingness to share required audit evidence.

Summary: Luminary Health Partners evaluated Redwood Private for PHI-bearing workloads (patient summarization, clinical chat). Strong technical fit: private deployment, KMS support, per-route routing. Procurement reached late 2025 after multiple demos.

Key quotes / fragments: "We need SOC2 Type II auditor letter and ISO27001 certificate with SoA — redacted summaries won't pass legal." 
"Our security team will not accept vendor self-attestation; must see third-party auditor evidence."

Timeline highlights: submitted our SOC2 summary and SoW, customer said redacted reports insufficient. Luminary InfoSec insisted on full auditor letter and penetration test report for any vendor with access to PHI. Legal flagged key custody questions around encryption-at-rest/HSM.

What we provided: Private deployment design, KMS integration notes, SOC2 summary, demo of PHI redaction pipeline. What customer wanted: full SOC2 Type II auditor letter tied to our hosted/private packaging, ISO27001 cert with statement of applicability, signed contract-level attestations.

Why lost: Luminary refused to accept our shared summaries and would not sign NDAs / exceptions requested to view full auditor evidence. Competitor (VaultAI) provided signed SOC2 attestation and HSM/key custody paperwork and offered a more prescriptive on-prem engagement; Luminary moved forward with them. Also internal budget freeze and loss of champion in clinical informatics after compliance pushback.

Next actions (AE notes): mark closed-lost; set 12-month cadence to check back after they complete vendor compliance program. Capture exact security gaps in STANDARDS board: auditor-letter access, SoA for private package, penetration test artifacts. Save all exchange threads.

Stubs/refs: Fireflies ff_20251103_01 (security Q&A), ff_20260115_02 (legal escalation). Drive: pricing deck + SSQ + SOC2 summary. Jira: REDW-4312 (encryption KMS questions), REDW-4599 (contract exceptions).
